overview:
{
  "app_name": "RelayAI MVP",
  "overview": "Single-file HTML/JS relationship management application with AI-powered message generation using Claude API. Manages contacts with tiered touch frequency tracking, overdue alerts, and automated outreach message creation. All data stored in localStorage with hardcoded authentication.",
  
  "views": [
    {
      "name": "login_view",
      "purpose": "Authentication gate - validates credentials and transitions to dashboard",
      "elements": [
        "Form element with id 'loginForm'",
        "Input field type=text name=username placeholder='Username'",
        "Input field type=password name=password placeholder='Password'",
        "Submit button text='Login'",
        "Error message div id='loginError' initially hidden",
        "App title 'RelayAI' with logo/icon",
        "Credential hint text '(admin/relayai2024)' in subtle styling"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Form submit event listener prevents default",
        "Validates username === 'admin' AND password === 'relayai2024'",
        "On success: set sessionStorage.loggedIn = 'true', hide login view, show dashboard",
        "On failure: display loginError div with message 'Invalid credentials', clear password field",
        "Enter key submits form"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "api_key_banner",
      "purpose": "Alert user when Anthropic API key is not configured",
      "elements": [
        "Banner div id='apiKeyBanner' with warning styling",
        "Warning icon or emoji ⚠️",
        "Text 'Anthropic API Key not configured. AI message generation disabled.'",
        "Instruction text 'Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY variable in script'",
        "Close button to dismiss banner temporarily"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Displayed at top of dashboard/contacts when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY === ''",
        "Close button hides banner with sessionStorage flag (reappears on refresh if still empty)",
        "Hidden entirely when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY has value"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "sidebar_navigation",
      "purpose": "Persistent navigation menu for switching between views",
      "elements": [
        "Nav element with id 'sidebar' background #0f3460",
        "App logo/title at top",
        "Navigation button id='navDashboard' text='Dashboard' icon=📊",
        "Navigation button id='navContacts' text='Contacts' icon=👥",
        "Navigation button id='navAddContact' text='+ New Contact' icon=➕",
        "Logout button at bottom id='logoutBtn' text='Logout' icon=🚪"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Click navDashboard: hide all views, show dashboard",
        "Click navContacts: hide all views, show contacts list",
        "Click navAddContact: hide all views, show add contact form (empty)",
        "Click logoutBtn: clear sessionStorage, hide all authenticated views, show login",
        "Active view button has highlight class (background #e94560)",
        "Sidebar collapses to icons-only on mobile (<768px)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "dashboard_view",
      "purpose": "Overview of contact health with key metrics and recent activity",
      "elements": [
        "Header 'Dashboard'",
        "Stats card section with 3 cards:",
        "  - Total Contacts count with icon 👥",
        "  - Overdue Contacts count with breakdown by tier with icon ⚠️",
        "  - Next Due contact name and days with icon 📅",
        "Overdue breakdown subsection showing:",
        "  - 'Tier A: X contacts' in red if > 0",
        "  - 'Tier B: X contacts' in orange if > 0", 
        "  - 'Tier C: X contacts' in yellow if > 0",
        "Recent Activity section:",
        "  - Header 'Recent Activity'",
        "  - List of last 10 activities sorted by date descending",
        "  - Each item shows: date, contact name, activity type, message preview (if applicable)",
        "  - Empty state 'No activity yet' if none",
        "Refresh data button id='refreshDashboard'"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "On view show: calculate all metrics from localStorage contacts",
        "Click contact name in activity: navigate to that contact's detail view",
        "Click refresh button: recalculate and re-render all data",
        "Overdue counts are clickable filters - navigate to contacts list filtered by tier"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "contacts_list_view",
      "purpose": "Sortable, filterable table of all contacts with status indicators",
      "elements": [
        "Header 'Contacts'",
        "Filter/search bar:",
        "  - Search input placeholder='Search contacts...' id='contactSearch'",
        "  - Tier filter dropdown: All, A, B, C id='tierFilter'",
        "  - Status filter: All, Overdue, Due Soon, Up to Date id='statusFilter'",
        "  - Sort dropdown: Name, Company, Last Contact, Days Overdue id='sortBy'",
        "Table with columns:",
        "  - Name (text)",
        "  - Company (text)",
        "  - Tier (badge A/B/C with colors: A=red, B=orange, C=green)",
        "  - Last Contact (date formatted MM/DD/YYYY)",
        "  - Days Overdue (number, red if positive, green if negative)",
        "  - Status indicator (icon: 🔴 overdue, 🟡 due soon within 3 days, 🟢 up to date)",
        "Each row clickable with hover effect",
        "Empty state 'No contacts found. Add your first contact!' with CTA button",
        "Contact count display 'Showing X contacts'"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Search input filters by name, company, email in real-time (debounce 300ms)",
        "Tier filter: shows only selected tier or all",
        "Status filter logic:",
        "  - Overdue: daysOverdue > 0",
        "  - Due Soon: daysOverdue between -3 and 0",
        "  - Up to Date: daysOverdue < -3",
        "Sort by: alphabetically or numerically depending on column",
        "Click row: navigate to contact detail view for that contact ID",
        "Hover row: background color change to #1e2a47",
        "Table scrolls horizontally on mobile",
        "Empty state CTA navigates to add contact form"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "contact_form_view",
      "purpose": "Add new or edit existing contact with validation",
      "elements": [
        "Header: 'Add Contact' or 'Edit Contact' (dynamic based on mode)",
        "Form element id='contactForm'",
        "Input field: Name (text, required) placeholder='Full Name'",
        "Input field: Company (text, required) placeholder='Company Name'",
        "Input field: Email (email, optional) placeholder='email@example.com'",
        "Input field: Phone (tel, optional) placeholder='(555) 123-4567'",
        "Select field: Tier (required) options: A, B, C",
        "Input field: Touch Frequency (number, required) label='Touch every X days' min=1",
        "Textarea: Notes (optional) placeholder='Background, interests, last conversation...' rows=4",
        "Input field: Last Contact Date (date, required) label='Last Contact Date'",
        "Button group:",
        "  - Save button id='saveContactBtn' text='Save Contact'",
        "  - Cancel button id='cancelContactBtn' text='Cancel'",
        "Tier helper text below select: 'A=7 days, B=30 days, C=90 days'",
        "Validation error div id='formErrors' initially hidden"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "On view show in ADD mode: clear all fields, set defaults (tier A, frequency 7, lastContactDate = today)",
        "On view show in EDIT mode: populate all fields from contact object",
        "Tier select change: auto-update frequency field (A=7, B=30, C=90) unless user has manually changed it",
        "Form validation on submit:",
        "  - Name required and non-empty",
        "  - Company required and non-empty",
        "  - Email format valid if provided (regex)",
        "  - Tier required (A/B/C)",
        "  - Touch frequency required, number, >= 1",
        "  - Last contact date required and valid date",
        "If validation fails: prevent submit, show formErrors div with specific issues",
        "If validation passes: call saveContact() function, navigate to contacts list, show success toast",
        "Cancel button: discard changes, navigate to contacts list (confirm if fields dirty)",
        "Auto-save to localStorage on successful save"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "contact_detail_view",
      "purpose": "Full contact information display with action buttons",
      "elements": [
        "Header with contact name",
        "Back button '← Back to Contacts'",
        "Contact card with sections:",
        "  - Company name (large text)",
        "  - Tier badge (same styling as list)",
        "  - Contact info section: email (clickable mailto), phone (clickable tel)",
        "  - Touch frequency: 'Every X days' text",
        "  - Last contact date with relative time '(X days ago)'",
        "  - Days overdue with color coding: red if positive, green if negative",
        "  - Notes section with full text, or 'No notes' placeholder",
        "Action buttons row:",
        "  - Edit button id='editContactBtn' icon=✏️",
        "  - Delete button id='deleteContactBtn' icon=🗑️ danger styling",
        "  - Generate Message button id='generateMsgBtn' icon=✨ accent styling",
        "Activity history section:",
        "  - Header 'Activity History'",
        "  - List of all messages sent to this contact",
        "  - Each item: date, message preview (truncated), view full button",
        "  - Empty state 'No messages yet'"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "Back button: navigate to contacts list",
        "Edit button: navigate to contact form in EDIT mode with this contact's data",
        "Delete button: show confirmation dialog 'Delete [name]? This cannot be undone.' with Cancel/Delete buttons",
        "  - Confirm delete: remove from localStorage, navigate to contacts list, show success toast",
        "Generate Message button: disabled if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is empty, otherwise navigate to message generation view",
        "View full message: expand message in modal or navigate to message detail",
        "Email link: opens mailto:[email]",
        "Phone link: opens tel:[phone]"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "message_generation_view",
      "purpose": "AI message generation interface with loading state and error handling",
      "elements": [
        "Header 'Generate Message for [Contact Name]'",
        "Contact context display (read-only):",
        "  - Name, Company, Tier",
        "  - Notes preview",
        "Loading state div id='genLoading' with spinner and text 'Generating personalized message...'",
        "Generated message display div id='genResult' initially hidden:",
        "  - Label 'Generated Message'",
        "  - Editable textarea id='generatedMsgText' rows=8",
        "  - Character count display",
        "  - Edit instructions 'Review and edit before approving'",
        "Error state div id='genError' initially hidden with retry button",
        "Button group:",
        "  - Approve button id='approveMsgBtn' accent styling",
        "  - Regenerate button id='regenerateMsgBtn'",
        "  - Cancel button id='cancelMsgBtn'",
        "Generation timestamp display"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "On view show: immediately trigger API call to generate message",
        "During generation: show genLoading, hide buttons except Cancel",
        "On success: hide genLoading, show genResult with message in textarea, enable all buttons",
        "On API error: hide genLoading, show genError with error message and Retry button",
        "Approve button click:",
        "  - Get text from textarea (may be edited)",
        "  - Create activity record: type='message_generated', text, date=now, approved=true",
        "  - Add to contact's activity array",
        "  - Update contact's lastContactDate to today",
        "  - Save to localStorage",
        "  - Navigate to contact detail view",
        "  - Show success toast 'Message approved and logged'",
        "Regenerate button: clear textarea, re-trigger API call",
        "Cancel button: navigate back to contact detail without saving",
        "Textarea editable: user can modify AI output before approving"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "toast_notification",
      "purpose": "Non-blocking feedback for user actions",
      "elements": [
        "Toast container div id='toastContainer' fixed position top-right",
        "Individual toast divs with:",
        "  - Message text",
        "  - Type indicator (success=green, error=red, info=blue)",
        "  - Auto-dismiss timer",
        "  - Close button"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "showToast(message, type) function creates toast",
        "Auto-dismiss after 3 seconds with fade out animation",
        "Click close button: immediate dismiss",
        "Multiple toasts stack vertically",
        "Max 3 visible toasts, oldest dismissed if more"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "confirm_dialog",
      "purpose": "Modal confirmation for destructive actions",
      "elements": [
        "Modal overlay id='confirmModal' initially hidden",
        "Dialog box center screen",
        "Message text id='confirmMessage'",
        "Button group:",
        "  - Confirm button id='confirmYes' danger styling",
        "  - Cancel button id='confirmNo' default styling"
      ],
      "interactions": [
        "showConfirm(message, callback) function displays modal",
        "Confirm button: execute callback, hide modal",
        "Cancel button: hide modal without action",
        "Click overlay: same as cancel",
        "ESC key: same as cancel",
        "Modal prevents body scroll"
      ]
    }
  ],

  "data_models": {
    "Contact": {
      "id": "string - UUID generated with crypto.randomUUID() or timestamp fallback",
      "name": "string - full name, required, max 100 chars",
      "company": "string - company name, required, max 100 chars",
      "email": "string - email address, optional, validated format",
      "phone": "string - phone number, optional, any format",
      "tier": "string - enum A/B/C, required, determines touch frequency",
      "touchFrequency": "number - days between contacts, required, min 1",
      "notes": "string - free text notes, optional, max 1000 chars",
      "lastContactDate": "string - ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD, required",
      "createdAt": "string - ISO timestamp, auto-generated on creation",
      "updatedAt": "string - ISO timestamp, auto-updated on edit",
      "activities": "array of Activity objects, empty array by default"
    },
    "Activity": {
      "id": "string - UUID or timestamp",
      "type": "string - enum: 'message_generated', 'manual_note', 'contact_added', 'contact_edited'",
      "date": "string - ISO timestamp of activity",
      "message": "string - message text if type=message_generated, optional otherwise",
      "approved": "boolean - true if message was approved, only for message_generated type",
      "metadata": "object - additional context, optional"
    },
    "AppState": {
      "currentView": "string - active view identifier",
      "currentContactId": "string - ID of contact being viewed/edited, null if none",
      "formMode": "string - 'add' or 'edit' for contact form",
      "filterState": "object - {search: string, tier: string, status: string, sortBy: string}",
      "apiKeyConfigured": "boolean - cached check of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY presence"
    }
  },

  "functions": [
    {
      "name": "initApp",
      "purpose": "Initialize application on page load",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Check sessionStorage.loggedIn",
        "If not 'true': show login view, hide all others",
        "If 'true': check ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, show banner if empty, load dashboard",
        "Attach all event listeners",
        "Load contacts from localStorage",
        "Initialize appState object",
        "Set up periodic check for overdue contacts (every 1 minute)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "handleLogin",
      "purpose": "Process login form submission",
      "inputs": ["event - form submit event"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "event.preventDefault()",
        "Get username and password from form inputs",
        "Trim whitespace from both",
        "Check if username === 'admin' AND password === 'relayai2024'",
        "If match:",
        "  - Set sessionStorage.loggedIn = 'true'",
        "  - Hide login view",
        "  - Call loadDashboard()",
        "  - Clear form",
        "If no match:",
        "  - Show loginError div",
        "  - Set error text 'Invalid credentials'",
        "  - Clear password field",
        "  - Focus username field"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "handleLogout",
      "purpose": "Log user out and return to login screen",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Clear sessionStorage.loggedIn",
        "Hide all authenticated views",
        "Show login view",
        "Reset appState to defaults",
        "Clear any active form data"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "loadContacts",
      "purpose": "Retrieve contacts array from localStorage",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "array of Contact objects",
      "logic": [
        "Get localStorage.getItem('relayai_contacts')",
        "If null or empty: return []",
        "Parse JSON",
        "Validate structure (array check)",
        "Return parsed array",
        "Catch any JSON parse errors, return [] and log error"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "saveContacts",
      "purpose": "Persist contacts array to localStorage",
      "inputs": ["contacts - array of Contact objects"],
      "outputs": "boolean - success status",
      "logic": [
        "Stringify contacts array",
        "Try localStorage.setItem('relayai_contacts', stringified)",
        "Return true on success",
        "Catch quota errors or other exceptions",
        "Show error toast 'Failed to save data'",
        "Return false"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "getContactById",
      "purpose": "Retrieve single contact by ID",
      "inputs": ["id - string contact ID"],
      "outputs": "Contact object or null",
      "logic": [
        "Call loadContacts()",
        "Use Array.find() with contact.id === id",
        "Return found contact or null"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "calculateDaysOverdue",
      "purpose": "Calculate how many days overdue a contact is",
      "inputs": ["contact - Contact object"],
      "outputs": "number - positive if overdue, negative if time remaining",
      "logic": [
        "Parse contact.lastContactDate as Date",
        "Get current date",
        "Calculate daysSinceContact = (now - lastContactDate) / (1000*60*60*24), floor result",
        "Calculate daysOverdue = daysSinceContact - contact.touchFrequency",
        "Return daysOverdue as integer"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "loadDashboard",
      "purpose": "Render dashboard view with calculated metrics",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Load contacts array",
        "Calculate total count",
        "Calculate overdue by tier:",
        "  - Filter contacts by tier A/B/C",
        "  - For each, call calculateDaysOverdue()",
        "  - Count where daysOverdue > 0",
        "Find next due contact:",
        "  - Filter contacts where daysOverdue < 0",
        "  - Sort by daysOverdue descending (closest to 0)",
        "  - Take first",
        "Load recent activities:",
        "  - Iterate all contacts",
        "  - Collect all activities from contact.activities arrays",
        "  - Sort by date descending",
        "  - Take first 10",
        "Update DOM:",
        "  - Set total count text",
        "  - Set overdue tier counts with color coding",
        "  - Set next due contact name and days",
        "  - Render activity list items",
        "Show dashboard view, hide others",
        "Update sidebar active state"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "loadContactsList",
      "purpose": "Render contacts list table with filters applied",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Load contacts array",
        "Get current filter values from appState or inputs",
        "Apply search filter:",
        "  - Filter contacts where name/company/email includes search text (case insensitive)",
        "Apply tier filter:",
        "  - If not 'All', filter where contact.tier === selected tier",
        "Apply status filter:",
        "  - Calculate daysOverdue for each",
        "  - If 'Overdue': keep where daysOverdue > 0",
        "  - If 'Due Soon': keep where -3 <= daysOverdue <= 0",
        "  - If 'Up to Date': keep where daysOverdue < -3",
        "Apply sort:",
        "  - Sort by selected column (name/company/lastContactDate/daysOverdue)",
        "  - Use localeCompare for strings, numeric compare for numbers",
        "Clear table body",
        "For each filtered contact:",
        "  - Create table row",
        "  - Create cells for each column",
        "  - Add tier badge with color",
        "  - Format date as MM/DD/YYYY",
        "  - Add status indicator icon based on daysOverdue",
        "  - Add click handler to row that calls showContactDetail(contact.id)",
        "  - Append row",
        "If no contacts: show empty state",
        "Update count display",
        "Show contacts list view, hide others",
        "Update sidebar active state"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "showContactForm",
      "purpose": "Display contact form in add or edit mode",
      "inputs": ["mode - string 'add' or 'edit'", "contactId - string or null"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Set appState.formMode = mode",
        "If mode === 'add':",
        "  - Clear all form inputs",
        "  - Set tier to 'A'",
        "  - Set touchFrequency to 7",
        "  - Set lastContactDate to today (YYYY-MM-DD format)",
        "  - Set header text to 'Add Contact'",
        "If mode === 'edit':",
        "  - Call getContactById(contactId)",
        "  - If not found: show error toast, return",
        "  - Populate all form fields from contact object",
        "  - Set header text to 'Edit Contact'",
        "  - Store contactId in appState.currentContactId",
        "Show contact form view, hide others",
        "Focus name input",
        "Clear any previous validation errors"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "validateContactForm",
      "purpose": "Validate all contact form fields",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "object {valid: boolean, errors: array of strings}",
      "logic": [
        "Get all form field values",
        "Initialize errors array",
        "Check name: if empty or whitespace only, add 'Name is required'",
        "Check company: if empty or whitespace only, add 'Company is required'",
        "Check email if provided: regex test /^[^@]+@[^@]+\\.[^@]+$/, add 'Invalid email format' if fails",
        "Check tier: if not A, B, or C, add 'Tier must be A, B, or C'",
        "Check touchFrequency: if not a number or < 1, add 'Touch frequency must be at least 1 day'",
        "Check lastContactDate: try parsing as date, if invalid add 'Invalid date format'",
        "Return {valid: errors.length === 0, errors: errors}"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "saveContact",
      "purpose": "Save new or edited contact to localStorage",
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": "boolean - success status",
      "logic": [
        "Call validateContactForm()",
        "If not valid:",
        "  - Display errors in formErrors div",
        "  - Return false",
        "Get form values",
        "Load contacts array",
        "If appState.formMode === 'add':",
        "  - Create new Contact object",
        "  - Generate id with crypto.randomUUID() or Date.now().toString()",
        "  - Set createdAt to now ISO string",
        "  - Set updatedAt to now ISO string",
        "  - Initialize activities as empty array",
        "  - Add activity: {type: 'contact_added', date: now}",
        "  - Push to contacts array",
        "If appState.formMode === 'edit':",
        "  - Find contact by appState.currentContactId",
        "  - Update all editable fields",
        "  - Set updatedAt to now ISO string",
        "  - Add activity: {type: 'contact_edited', date: now}",
        "Call saveContacts(contacts)",
        "If save successful:",
        "  - Show toast 'Contact saved successfully'",
        "  - Call loadContactsList()",
        "  - Return true",
        "Else:",
        "  - Return false"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "deleteContact",
      "purpose": "Remove contact from localStorage after confirmation",
      "inputs": ["contactId - string"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Get contact by ID",
        "If not found: show error toast, return",
        "Call showConfirm('Delete ' + contact.name + '? This cannot be undone.', callback)",
        "Callback function:",
        "  - Load contacts array",
        "  - Filter out contact where id === contactId",
        "  - Call saveContacts(filtered array)",
        "  - Show toast 'Contact deleted'",
        "  - Call loadContactsList()"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "showContactDetail",
      "purpose": "Display detailed view of a single contact",
      "inputs": ["contactId - string"],
      "outputs": "void",
      "logic": [
        "Call getContactById(contactId)",
        "If not found: show error toast, return",
        "Set appState.currentContactId = contactId",
        "Update DOM:",
        "  - Set header to contact.name",
        "  - Set company name",
        "  - Render tier badge",
        "  - Set email with mailto link",
        "  - Set phone with tel link",
        "  - Set touch frequency text",
        "  - Format and set lastContactDate",
        "  - Calculate and display daysOverdue with color",
        "  - Calculate relative time (X days ago)",
        "  - Display notes or placeholder",
        "  - Render activity history list sorted by date desc",
        "Show contact detail view, hide others",
        "Enable/disable Generate Message button based on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "generateMessage",
      "purpose": "Call Anthropic API to generate personalized message",
      "inputs": ["contactId - string"],
      "outputs": "Promise resolving to string message or throwing error",
      "logic": [
        "Get contact by ID",
        "If not found: throw error 'Contact not found'",
        "If ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is empty: throw error 'API key not configured'",
        "Construct prompt:",
        "  'You are writing a genuine, personal outreach message to maintain a professional relationship.",
        "  Contact: [name] at [company]",
        "  Relationship tier: [tier] (A=close/frequent, B=regular, C=occasional)",
        "  Context notes: [notes or 'No previous notes']",
        "  Write a warm, authentic message that:',
        "  - References something specific if notes provide context",
        "  - Is appropriate for the relationship tier",
        "  - Suggests a low-pressure way to reconnect",
        "  - Is 2-3 sentences maximum",
        "  - Sounds like a real human, not corporate",
        "  Do not include subject line or greeting/signature. Just the message body.'",
        "Make fetch request:",
        "  URL: 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages'",
        "  Method: POST",
        "  Headers:",
        "    'x-api-key': ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
        "    'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'",
        "    'content-type': 'application/json'",
        "  Body: JSON.stringify({",
        "    model: 'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022',",
        "    max_tokens: 256,",
        "    messages: [{role: 'user', content: prompt}]",
        "  })",
        "Await response",
        "If not response.ok: throw error with status and statusText",
        "Parse JSON response",
        "Extract message text from response.content[0].text",
        "Return message text"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "showMessageGeneration",
      "purpose": "Display message generation view and trigger API call",
